description: A man in a black tailcoat, white waistcoat and black bow tie leans over a white clawfoot bathtub, looking down at a pair of pince-nez on the rim. He wears a monocle on a dark ribbon. Behind him are dark damask wallpaper, a grey subway-tile wall, brass pipes and a faucet, and a lit gas-style lamp on the right. The style is a dark, loose oil painting. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no text except a tiny mark in the bottom-right corner.
